kaa.solution_md: Kritikalıq noqatlar: $-8,\ -4,\ 2,\ 6$. Aralıqlar usılı: ońnan baslap belgi $+$, hár bir noqatta almasadı; bólimniń nolleri ($x=-8$, $x=6$) hámme waqıt shıǵarıp taslanadı, alımnıń nolleri kiredi. Pútin sheshimler sanı $8$. Juwap: $8$.
kaa.mistake_note_md: Bólimniń nollerin de sheshimge qosıp jiberiw yamasa belgilerdi aralıqlarǵa qáte qoyıw.

en.stem_md: How many integer solutions does the inequality $\frac{(x-2)(x+4)}{(x+8)(x-6)}\le0$ have?
en.solution_md: Critical points: $-8,\ -4,\ 2,\ 6$. Interval method: the sign is $+$ on the right and changes at every point; zeros of the denominator ($x=-8$, $x=6$) are always excluded, zeros of the numerator are included. There are $8$ integer solutions. Answer: $8$.
en.mistake_note_md: Including zeros of the denominator in the answer, or misplacing the signs on the intervals.
